# Azure DevOps tenant notes

Read this file only when the active client overlay declares an Azure DevOps tenant.

- Score delivery and change-management dimensions with `sre-ado-delivery-metrics` output and
  `sre-ado-org-governance` findings as evidence.
- Record the tenant profile (A/B/C) and ADO flavor in the report scope section.
- Roadmap items reference the ADO skills that deliver them.
